title: The hottest AI wearables and gadgets you should know about
slides: Which AI wearable actually survives past week one?
The market is flooded with pendants, rings, and pins
Most ship without real battery or privacy fixes
Check return windows before committing to a device
Pick one gadget and test it for seven days
thread_text:
1. Which AI wearable survives week one?

Most pendants, rings, and pins ship with missing battery or privacy fixes. The real test is seven days of daily use.

2. The market is flooded

Every company wants a spot on your body, from your finger to your collar. The hardware is easy; the follow-through is rare.

3. No privacy fix in sight

Always-on sensors mean constant data capture, but few brands explain where it goes. Check the policy before you check the price.

4. Return windows are your safety net

Most stores give you 14 to 30 days to back out. Read the fine print before the box arrives, not after.

5. Pick one and test it for seven days

Wear it through real work and real sleep. If it annoys you by day three, return it.
